# Lucas Cipriano

> Lucas Cipriano is a Brazilian Product Designer based in Lisbon, Portugal, with 8 years of experience designing digital products used by millions in fintech, education, TV and streaming, social networks and the creator economy. Currently at Privacy; previously at NOS, Globo and Cielo. Open to on-site roles in Portugal and Europe, and remote roles for the USA, Latin America and Brazil.

The site is available in English (/en) and Brazilian Portuguese (/pt-br).
